AI For Business: Practical Prompting for Everyday Work

Tuesday, November 17, 2026 (5:30 PM - 7:00 PM) (EST)

Description

Want better results from AI? It starts with knowing what to ask and how to ask it. This practical, beginner-friendly workshop will show you how to give AI clearer instructions, better context, and useful feedback so you can get more relevant and reliable results. You’ll learn a simple, repeatable approach you can use with tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, and other AI platforms to: Write stronger prompts Improve responses that miss the mark Add the right context and details Adapt prompts for everyday work tasks Build prompts you can use again and again Register here: https://sovainnovationhub.com/ai-programs/ai-workshops-for-business/
